rationale: The material prompt requirement is audio generation and final WAV delivery. At # Narration Script, the source is scoped to Write the spoken voiceover for a tutorial or demo - the actual words, phrased for the ear and synced one-instruction-per-action to what is on screen, with a pacing budget and a confident, jargon-checked tone. Use when someone says "write the voiceover", "script the narration", "what should I say ove; it provides a meaningful neighbouring route but does not establish audio generation and final WAV delivery as required by the prompt.
